task: Prior-art extraction for the stationary collective J+/J- bath family and full-separability trace-distance exponent
scope_limit: Primary-source focused check; not a systematic or global novelty review.

sources.title: Stationary entanglement and nonlocality of two qubits or qutrits collectively interacting with the thermal environment: The role of Bell singlet state
sources.read_depth: Primary PDF and HTML; reconstructed the two-qubit concurrence criterion from Eqs. (1), (3), (10).
sources.reported_claim: Same two-qubit collective thermal J± master equation; for the maximally mixed Werner input r=0, stationary entanglement occurs iff bath occupation nbar < (sqrt(15)-3)/6. This is the N=2 instance of the later singleton threshold.
sources.not_claimed: No all-N Schur-Weyl weight theorem; no N-dependent occupation exponent; no trace-distance-to-full-SEP limit.

sources.title: Spin squeezing and entanglement
sources.read_depth: Primary PDF; read Eq. (7b) and proof on p. 3 plus thermal-model application sections.
sources.reported_claim: For fully separable N-qubit states, sum_a Var(J_a) >= N/2; violation witnesses entanglement. Generalized spin-squeezing inequalities are applied to thermal spin models.
sources.not_claimed: This is an entanglement witness, not a full-separability characterization or a trace-distance estimate.

sources.title: Estimating the best separable approximation of non-pure spin-squeezed states
sources.read_depth: Primary journal page and PDF; read state/metric definitions, generalized SSIs, BSA theorem, model and thermal results.
sources.reported_claim: Studies distances/entanglement of collective-spin thermal states using BSA, a minimum entangled remainder weight, and lower/upper bounds; derives BSA bounds from generalized spin-squeezing inequalities; evaluates fully-connected XXZ Gibbs states.
sources.specific_overlap: Setting g_z=g>0 in Eq. (20) gives the isotropic all-to-all antiferromagnet; Eq. (22) then includes Z_N^{-1} exp[-A J^2/N - b J_z/sqrt(N)] with A=beta g and beta h_N=b/sqrt(N), up to field sign convention. Their symmetric SEP ansatz Eq. (33) is a positive mixture of twirled product states over all J sectors.
sources.not_claimed: The input-selected J± bath stationary state is not this Gibbs state. Mathé et al. do not give a half trace-norm convergence theorem for the particular reweighted Bloch-product mixture or the b/sqrt(N) field sequence; their main quantitative object is BSA/GR, not min_sigma 1/2||rho-sigma||_1. No D(rho,SEP)->0/1 exponent for the bath state is given.

sources.title: Thermal entanglement transitions from strong SU(2) symmetry
sources.read_depth: Primary arXiv HTML and PDF; read abstract, singlet Gibbs definition, bipartite measures, transition/scaling sections and discussion.
sources.reported_claim: In global-singlet Gibbs states of locally interacting ferromagnets, finite-temperature ordering transitions coincide with changes in the size scaling of half-vs-half distillable entanglement and logarithmic negativity.
sources.not_claimed: Different state constraint and metric: fixed total-singlet sector and bipartite entanglement, not the J± bath state with weights across all j or distance to full SEP.

sources.title: Symmetry enforced entanglement in maximally mixed states
sources.read_depth: Primary PDF and HTML; read main results, symmetry-sector definition, channel assumptions, and bipartite entanglement sections.
sources.reported_claim: Maximally mixed invariant state in a fixed symmetry sector; Abelian MMIS such as U(1) is fully separable, while continuous non-Abelian SU(2) MMIS is bipartitely entangled with logarithmic half-system scaling.
sources.not_claimed: Not the finite-occupation non-unital J± bath trajectory from I/2^N; fixed-sector MMIS and bipartite measures differ from full-SEP trace distance.

sources.title: Thermal Activation of Divergent Distillable Entanglement under Non-Abelian Strong Symmetry
sources.read_depth: Primary PDF and arXiv metadata; read Theorem 1 and the representation-space distillation construction.
sources.reported_claim: For finite-range locally SU(2)-invariant chains in the global-singlet sector, a high-temperature interval supports half-chain distillation yield (1/2)log_2 N + O_beta(1).
sources.not_claimed: Global-singlet sector and bipartite distillation, not the collective J± bath family or trace distance to full SEP.

sources.title: Absence of Entanglement Growth in Dicke Superradiance
sources.read_depth: Primary APS article and arXiv PDF; read abstract, Secs. II and IV, and conclusion.
sources.reported_claim: For ideal Dicke collective emission from a fully excited state, the state remains in the symmetric j=N/2 sector and is exactly separable at every time. The paper characterizes diagonal symmetric states by positive mixtures of spin-coherent product states via the truncated Hausdorff moment problem.
sources.not_claimed: This is exact coherent-state separability in the maximal-spin sector under zero-temperature emission, not an all-j Gibbs approximation, not the J± finite-occupation stationary state, and not a trace-distance asymptotic bound.

already_known: Two-qubit collective thermal bath activation from a maximally mixed input, with the exact N=2 occupation threshold.
The full-separability variance inequality sum_a Var(J_a) >= N/2 and generalized collective spin-squeezing witnesses.
Quantitative full-SEP entanglement analysis for collective-spin thermal states using BSA and SSI bounds.

The candidate mean-field AFM Gibbs operator exp[-A J^2/N - b J_z/sqrt(N)] is within Mathé et al.'s fully-connected XXZ thermal family; explicit positive mixtures of twirled product states are already used as SEP ansätze.
Exact positive spin-coherent decompositions and separability for zero-temperature Dicke superradiant decay in the maximal-spin sector.
Finite-temperature entanglement transitions in global-singlet Gibbs states, measured by half-system distillable entanglement/logarithmic negativity.
not_found_in_inspected_sources: The specific all-N stationary state with Schur-Weyl sector weights inherited from I/2^N and thermal m-distribution within each j sector.
The half trace-norm distance D(rho_N(nu_N),SEP_N) having a polynomial occupation exponent 1/2 for that state family.
A half trace-norm convergence theorem for the particular reweighted isotropic Bloch-product mixture approximating exp[-A J^2/N - b J_z/sqrt(N)] at b fixed.
A matching explicit limiting Euler/Brownian-bridge tail error formula for the high-bath critical scaling.
candidate_narrowing.status: Scoped primary-source check only; absence from these inspected sources is not novelty certification.
